payload.answer: One focused test per decision kind -- six tests: VISUAL_DESIGN opted_in / declined / accepted / waived, and DEPLOYMENT opted_in / declined. Each builds the minimal ledger that reaches that state and asserts the resulting banner value. Composite scenarios are the wrong shape here: the branches are a single elif chain, so a composite test passes as long as ANY arm fires and tells you nothing about which. Add one seventh test for the chain's implicit else -- a ledger containing only unrelated event kinds, where both banners must stay None. That arm has no elif of its own, which is exactly why it is easy to leave uncovered.
